data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2014 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 361.8m. During 2014 prior-year claims developed adversely: the syndicate reports a net deterioration of GBP 11.1m in respect of claims outstanding at the prior year end, driven by specific adverse developments (notably New Zealand earthquake notifications and the emergence of the Talisman claim) and reserve strengthening in certain liability/professional lines. The adverse movement predominantly affected Property and certain Professional/Energy related accounts; no comprehensive gross prior-year movement was published, so the reported net deterioration has been used as the quantified indicator.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 11.1m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: release of GBP 6.2m).
recognition of the Talisman claim, an emergence of a loss attaching to an historic Year of Account, has been required in the period.
increased notifications on the New Zealand earthquake claims have required strengthening of reserves on prior years,
two very specific accounts that have required reserve strengthening.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was provided in the technical reserves notes. The report contains an explicit NET prior-year deterioration of GBP 11.1m which has been used as a fallback (flagged above). Opening gross claims outstanding is taken from the 2013 balance sheet closing figure. Where only narrative references to specific account-level deteriorations exist, amounts are not quantified and have been left null. Confidence in the quantified PYD is reduced because it is NET of reinsurance rather than the requested GROSS figure.
